draft: The sun rises over Mexico City, casting golden light on the bustling metropolis with minimal pollution. Harmony reigns as people enjoy mild weather, civil interactions, and trust in institutions. Economic activity thrives through cooperative credit systems, mutual-aid networks, and lively markets. This balance between authoritarian governance, environmental sustainability, social cohesion, and economic opportunity has created a stable foundation for residents to flourish in this alternate version of the present-day Mexico City.
